build_ant_walker: build an Ant quadruped walker entity from the dm_control MJCF XML model file
create_ant_observables: create AntObservables to expose appendages_pos, bodies_quats, and bodies_pos sensor data
test_ant_aliveness: test the Ant aliveness method which returns torso vertical orientation normalized to zero to one
refactor_ant_actuators: refactor the Ant walker actuators property to return all MJCF actuator elements from the model
review_ant_proprioception: review the AntObservables proprioception property combining joints, body height, end effectors, and world zaxis
